project.name: Cyberwave 2199
project.pitch: Retrofuturistic cyberpunk combat kart racing: luxury neon cars, drift boosts, weapons and fourteen real-world circuits, against seven AI rivals or in 2–4 player local split screen.
workflow: Work on main. Commits are made by hand once a change has been playtested.
Before committing a system change, run its quick test below (headless), then the manual check in the editor.
When a design rule changes, bump the GDD version and add a Revision History row; log the call here in the Decision log.
Update this tracker in the browser, press Export JSON, overwrite dev/tracker.json, and commit it with the work it describes.
Run test_phase4 and test_phase6 on their own: they're long and time-sensitive.

folders.what: VehicleController (raycast suspension, grip), DriftController, recovery, feedback
RaceManager, StartLaunch (rocket start), checkpoints, championship, split screen
WeaponManager, WeaponData, StatusEffects, CombatSfx, projectiles and drones
TrackCircuit, TrackFeature, per-track scenery and reusable builders
RaceHUD parts (hud/), podium, neon menu widgets, garage preview
Vehicle stats, weapon .tres (odds, durations), AI difficulty, cups
Headless suites; tools/ has screenshot and probe scripts
GDD, Reference, physics guide, advanced weapons, recovery

milestones.title: Kart handling & raycast suspension
milestones.summary: Four RayCast3D wheels apply spring/damper forces to a RigidBody3D. Drive, lateral grip and yaw shape the velocity in _integrate_forces for arcade handling. The 2026-11-10 physics pass added a per-step wheel cache, traction weighting and a landing stabiliser. What's left is feel.
prerequisites: Physics guide §13 (the results of the last pass) read
F3 PhysicsDebugOverlay works in races and Practice

steps.text: Per-step wheel cache: spring length, compression, load and ray hits
traction_fraction weighted by compression, with a 2-tick grace
Landing: 1.5× damping and a 0.3 s pitch/roll stabiliser after more than 0.15 s in the air
Anti-roll bars wired (find_axles + anti_roll_stiffness) but left at 0
Cars drawn 1.3× on track (visual only; collider and rays unchanged)
Playtest top speed, acceleration and grip for every car on 3+ tracks
Check kerbs and bumps (Kilwa, Catacombs) never launch or flip a car
Re-check ramp jump distances after any spring or damper change
Write the final VehicleStats values into GDD §5.2

test.manual: Practice → press F3. Watch per-wheel compression and traction through T3 and the hairpins. Then take a Six Flags ramp: the car should land on its wheels and settle in about 0.3 s.

milestones.notes: Don't clamp spring force at full travel: ramp take-offs rely on it. Higher damping or force caps also shorten jumps. Anti-roll stays at 0 because grip is velocity-driven, so there's no real cornering roll and bars only make kerbs worse.
milestones.open_decisions:
Is top speed right after the earlier 'lower top speed' request?
Anti-roll: keep at 0, or give heavier cars a small value?
Camera jitter on high-refresh monitors: turn on physics interpolation?
milestones.next_steps: Drive one car from each class on Vegas, Catacombs and Kilwa and note understeer and oversteer per corner type.

milestones.title: Drifting & boost charge timing
milestones.summary: Hold drift and steer to slide. Charge builds only while grounded and sliding sideways: Cyan at 1 s, Magenta at 2.5 s, Gold at 4 s of neutral steering, 1.5× faster steering into the drift and 0.75× steering out. Releasing fires the boost.
prerequisites: Handling milestone stable enough that grip changes don't shift drift entry
Test Circuit T3 (133°) and T7 (95°) used as reference corners

steps.text: Three charge levels with tier colours and tones
charge_rate(steer): 1.5× into the drift, 0.75× out
Drift-entry hop and body angled into the slide (visual only)
Grip blends back over drift_recovery_time = 0.15 s
Tyre smoke, skid loop, sparks and underglow in the tier colour
AI drift zones on the racing line
Playtest: can Gold be reached on the 35–60 m corners of the newer tracks?
Tune boost speed and duration per tier (GDD §18 still open)
Re-check AI drift-boost counts after any timing change (test_phase2)

test.also: test_phase1.gd (simulated Gold drift), test_phase2.gd (AI drift boosts)
test.manual: Practice → T3: hold drift into the corner while steering in. Gold should arrive in about 2.7 s. Release and feel the boost; the HUD gauge cells should match the tier colour.

milestones.notes: drift_recovery_time 0.3 broke the phase2 AI drift-boost count, and 0.15 is the tested value. Leaving the ground pauses charging; more than 1.5 s airborne, a hard hit or slowing well below drift speed cancels it.
milestones.open_decisions:
Boost multipliers and durations per tier.
Should Gold need less than 4 s neutral now that corners are tighter on newer tracks?
milestones.next_steps: Time Gold on one corner per cup and list which tracks allow it.

milestones.title: Weapons / item balance & System Override recovery
milestones.summary: There are 11 data-driven weapons with crate odds for each position: weak and defensive items at the front, powerful comeback items at the back. System Override hacks every racer ahead of the user, and the time to recover depends on the victim's position, so racers farther ahead stay hacked longer: 1st 12 s down to 7th 3 s.
prerequisites: Recovery rules settled (some recoveries empty the item slots)
AI difficulty pace roughly right, so position-based odds are meaningful

steps.text: 11 weapons as WeaponData resources

position_chance per weapon and per position (each sums to 100): Road Spikes 1st–3rd only, Firewalls 1st–5th only, rare items never for 1st–2nd, 7th–8th mostly Overdrive / Override / Triple Nitro (v7.4)
System Override: duration_by_position 12 / 10.5 / 9 / 7.5 / 6 / 4.5 / 3 s, −25% speed, −30% accel, no drift charge, no stacking
Hunter-Killer pierces Firewall; Nitro dodge in the last 0.4 s
Item loss on out-of-bounds / water / off-track / manual recoveries
Weapon SFX with per-clip levels and a master limiter
Find why test_weapons_advanced's System Override top-speed / acceleration checks fail
Human playtest of Override durations from the leader's seat
Playtest crate odds over a full Grand Prix (leader vs back of the pack)
Find why test_phase3 'every racer crossed every gate despite weapons' fails
Decide on the 5 unbuilt GDD weapons (Holo Decoy, Gravity Mine, System Glitch, Cyber Leech, Swarm Bots)

test.manual: Versus on Vegas, Items on, start 8th. Fire a System Override from 7th: every car ahead shows red arcs, and the effects timer reads longer the farther ahead that car is (leader 12 s). A repeat Override does nothing.

milestones.blockers: test_phase3 full-race gate check fails. It fails with the old odds too, so the v7.4 rebalance didn't cause it; the cause hasn't been checked. test_weapons_advanced: 2 System Override speed / acceleration checks also fail, with the old odds as well.
milestones.notes: Override durations are 3× the original spec (your call, GDD v5.1). The 8th-place value (1.5 s) never applies because nobody is behind 8th. Weapons stay usable while hacked.
milestones.open_decisions:
12 s for the leader: keep or trim?
Build any of the 5 remaining GDD weapons, or drop them from §6.3?
AI tends to spend Firewalls pre-emptively: fix or accept?
milestones.next_steps: Play 3 Versus races leading, and 3 from the back, then note how often Override decides the race.

prerequisites: Judge looks on Windows Forward+ (container screenshots are software-rendered)
Water / EMP shaders committed before tuning per-track tints

Music on every track, faster on the final lap

Arashiyama bamboo reworked (straight jointed culms, crowns meeting overhead)
See-through light beams removed (Catacombs grates, glacier skylights, Crazy House windows, Arashiyama canopy) (v6.8)
Boost pads laid out as single / diagonal / triangle, fixed per track (v6.6)

Sloped and banked roads on Gardens by the Bay and Vale da Lua (v7.1–7.2)
Poly Haven textures on every track (v7.2)
Correct GDD §12.1: Kilwa now has music (The Dragon's Lair)

test.manual: Versus → each cup's tracks at 1080p with Debug → Monitors open (FPS). Check that water and EMP puddles read at full speed and fog never hides a corner.

milestones.blockers: Arashiyama: 'shortcut is shorter (350 vs 470)' and 'every gate counted on the shortcut' fail.

milestones.title: HUD & garage UI
milestones.summary: The race HUD was rebuilt after the 'Slipstream Under the Neon Moon' art (v4.9). The garage is a full-screen neon room, and results, pause and podium are restyled. What's left is on-screen checks and the remaining GDD §11.8 presentation items.
prerequisites: Reference art in 'reference files/' for any screen being restyled
UIStyle / Neon* widgets reused (no one-off styling)

steps.text: HUD: POSITION + standings, LAP / time / coins, speed gauge with charge cells, minimap over item squares
Neon results (two pages for sets) and podium ceremony
Pause menu with volume and controls keycaps (v6.0)
Garage room with COSMETICS / INFO tabs, turntable, Apply
Loading card with progress bar
HUD reads "2/8", "1/3" and 00:23.567; mode / track line removed (v6.9)
Results: PTS column in every race, projected times for racers placed without finishing, DNF only for last place / Elimination runner-up (v6.5–6.6)
Split screen uses the single-player results layout with player-coloured rows (v6.7)
Race setup defaults: Standard, 3 races, 3 laps, Normal, items on; Multiplayer the same with NPCs on; choices last until the game closes (v7.4)
On-screen check of the HUD at 75% and 150% scale in 1P and 3–4P split screen
Garage: try on every cosmetic on all 8 cars and check stripes and decals line up
Decide on the GDD §11.8 pre-race camera sweep and the §11.9 first-time tutorial

test.also: test_phase5.gd (menus, garage, shop), test_podium.gd, test_race_end.gd (projected times, DNF)
test.manual: Garage: try on and apply one item per category on two cars. Then race, pause, and finish. The podium should show, then results; play a Versus set to see both results pages.

milestones.notes: No control instructions on the HUD (pause menu only). Coins show as a count plus the coin symbol, never the word COINS. There are no coins in split screen.

Pre-race camera sweep: build or drop?

milestones.title: Starting lights & rocket start
milestones.summary: A four-lamp start-light board on the gantry lights one lamp per beep: three reds, then green on START. The new rocket start (GDD v6.4) gives a boost for holding accelerate as the '2' fades and a burnout for holding too early. AI rivals do it too, with odds set by difficulty.
prerequisites: Countdown beeps aligned with the lamps (clip played from 0 s, beeps 1 s apart)
Tests that freeze AI neutralise launches (test_phase3 _freeze_field, test_phase2 no_launches)

steps.text: Start-light board on the gantry, one lamp per beep, lights out 4 s after START
3 / 2 / 1 / START countdown with controls locked
StartLaunch per racer: rocket window as '2' fades; earlier = burnout (smoke, spin, 1 s no control)
Revving before START: exhaust pops, rear squat, body shudder
AI odds per difficulty (rocket_start_chance / burnout_chance)
Playtest the window width with keyboard and a gamepad
Check lamp / beep / word sync on Windows Forward+ and in the web build
Check AI odds feel per difficulty (Easy 15% / 20%, Normal 40% / 8%, Hard 80% / 2%)
Commit start_launch.gd and test_start_boost.gd (done in cf3fb49)

test.manual: F6 race on Vegas. Hold RT exactly as the '2' fades for a boost. Hold from '3' and you should get burnout smoke and 1 s with no control. Watch that each lamp lights on its beep.

milestones.notes: Replaces the old 'no false-start penalties' rule. Boost size equals a level-2 (Magenta) drift boost.
milestones.open_decisions:
Rocket window width: keep or widen for gamepad triggers?
Keep the boost at Magenta size?
milestones.next_steps: Ten starts each on keyboard and pad; note the success rate, then adjust the window.

milestones.title: Controller support
milestones.summary: Gamepads drive, fight and navigate every menu. Split screen gives each device its own p1_–p4_ actions, and controller kinds (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, generic) are recognised for icons. Real-pad testing is the gap.
prerequisites: At least two physical gamepads (one Xbox-style, one PlayStation-style)

steps.text: Default pad bindings: RT / LT, RB drift, LB weapon, Y trick, D-pad slots / reset / camera, RS look back
Per-player actions (InputSetup.build_player_actions) for split screen
DeviceInput.controller_kind + ControllerIcon on the connect screen
A / B in single-player menus, pause, podium and results (v5.6)
Rebinding keyboard and pad separately, including stick directions
Controller vibration on boosts, tricks, hits and crashes, with a Settings toggle (v7.3)
Real-pad pass through every menu with Xbox and PlayStation pads
3–4P split screen with real pads on a heavy track
Decide and build pad-disconnect handling mid-race

test.manual: Plug in two pads. Multiplayer → join both plus the keyboard, pick cars on each device, race 3P, pause from P2's Start, and finish to the shared results using A only.

milestones.blockers: Needs real gamepads; this can't be checked headless.
milestones.notes: Godot's ui_accept / ui_cancel have no pad buttons by default, so InputSetup adds A and B. Space never presses menu buttons.
milestones.open_decisions:
Rumble on hits and boosts?
Pad disconnect mid-race: pause with a reconnect prompt?
milestones.next_steps: Run the manual check above with whatever pads are on hand and log any input that doesn't work.

Drift entry (hop) is reliable on keyboard and pad

Lamps, beeps and 3 / 2 / 1 / START line up

Hunter-Killer warning gives enough time to dodge

Every hit is readable (visual + sound)
From 7th–8th you mostly get Overdrive, System Override or Triple Nitro; never a single spike or a Firewall
Corners are visible through the fog on every track
Water and EMP puddles read at full speed
Frame rate holds on the heaviest tracks
Position, lap and item are readable at a glance
Nothing overlaps at 150% HUD scale
Garage try-on / Apply is clear without instructions
Every menu works with a pad alone
Split screen: each pad controls only its own car
